facts.text: The resort is located on Mina Al Fajer in Fujairah.
facts.excerpt: Our 5-star beach resort, Fairmont Fujairah is located on Mina Al Fajer, in Suwayfah, Al Fqait.

facts.text: The design theme combines modern bohemian elegance with arabesque-infused art deco.
facts.excerpt: a sophisticated design theme in which modern bohemian elegance meets arabesque-infused art deco.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as Fujairah's only art-inspired hotel.
facts.excerpt: As Fujairah’s only art-inspired hotel

facts.text: Guest rooms and suites have views of the marina or of the Gulf of Oman.
facts.excerpt: all with serene views of the marina or sweeping across the Gulf of Oman

facts.text: One-bedroom suites have views of the sea and adjacent mountains, plus two balconies.
facts.excerpt: One-bedroom suites have great views of the sea and adjacent mountains, plus two balconies.

facts.text: Suite bathtubs are deep and designed so guests can soak and look out on the view.
facts.excerpt: Bathtubs in the suite are deep, and the excellent design means you can soak and look out on the view.

facts.text: The Two Bedroom Suite has interconnecting rooms and a marina view, and is described as suited to 4 adults and 2 children.
facts.excerpt: Perfect for 4 adults and 2 children, One King Bed and Two Queen Beds, Non-Smoking, Interconnecting rooms, Marina View

facts.text: Arteasan serves a High Afternoon Tea with savory bites, pastries and sweet treats.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a sophisticated High Afternoon Tea experience at Arteasan.

facts.text: Canvas Rooftop Pool Bar offers open-air dinners with sea views.
facts.excerpt: a romantic dinner at the Canvas Rooftop Pool Bar, where breathtaking sea views meet an elegant open-air ambiance

facts.text: Copper Lobster serves a three-course coastal dining experience.
facts.excerpt: Discover the flavours of the coast through an elegantly curated three-course dining experience at Copper Lobster.

facts.text: Dining includes all-day dining, a tea lounge, a seafood restaurant and a European-style bistro.
facts.excerpt: Different restaurant choices include all-day dining, a tea lounge, a seafood restaurant, and a European-style bistro.

facts.text: Lava Beach Club has beach and pool facilities, a kids club, a play area, face painting and games.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy exclusive beach and pool facilities, a kids club, play area, face painting, and games.

facts.text: Water sports include jet skiing and banana boat rides, as well as kayaks, paddleboards and sailing boats.
facts.excerpt: Opt for some high-octane sports like Jet Skiing or Banana riding. Or relax with the stunning scenery on a kayak, paddleboard, or sailing boat.

facts.text: The resort offers sunset yoga.
facts.excerpt: reset your intentions through this unique sunset yoga experience in Fujairah.

facts.text: The pool is elaborately tiled and has sunset views across the sea.
facts.excerpt: The elaborately tiled pool has beautiful sunset views across the sea.

facts.text: The resort has a spa and a gym.
facts.excerpt: Yes, our beach resort offers a luxury spa for unwinding moments and relaxing rejuvenation during your stay at our hotel.

facts.text: Wi-Fi is complimentary, with speed upgrades available.
facts.excerpt: Wi-Fi is complimentary, but speed upgrades are available.

facts.text: Check-in is at 3:00PM and check-out is at 12:00PM.
facts.excerpt: Check in is at 3:00PM and check-out is at 12:00PM.

facts.text: Parking is included.
facts.excerpt: DetailsParking included

facts.text: There is not much to do in the immediate neighborhood, as the area around the hotel is new.
facts.excerpt: The area surrounding the hotel is new, so there's not much to do in the immediate neighborhood, but the on-site amenities soften the blow.
